# HumanoidSoccer Docker

Independent MuJoCo 3.3.1 / ONNX Runtime 1.22.1 / Python 3.11 mirrors, independent of Isaac Sim or other benchmark mirrors. NVIDIA Container Toolkit is required to provide EGL offscreen rendering with the host driving unchanged.

```bash
# World Root Directory
 docker build -t world/humanoid-soccer:mujoco3.3.1 -f third_party/benchmarks/humanoid_soccer/docker/Dockerfile third_party/benchmarks/humanoid_soccer/docker
python3 third_party/benchmarks/humanoid_soccer/docker/run.py --mode baseline --seed 7 --output "$PWD/var/runs/docker/humanoid_soccer/my-baseline"
python3 third_party/benchmarks/humanoid_soccer/docker/run.py --mode hybrid --model gpt-6-astra --codex-home "$PWD/var/auth/my-codex" --seed 7 --output "$PWD/var/runs/docker/humanoid_soccer/my-hybrid"
python3 third_party/benchmarks/humanoid_soccer/docker/run.py --mode direct --model gpt-6-astra --codex-home "$PWD/var/auth/my-codex" --seed 7 --output "$PWD/var/runs/docker/humanoid_soccer/my-direct"
```

Default geostationary, `--moving-ball` uses the official random initial ball speed option. Default 6 seconds, 300 control steps; `--sim-time` is used only for visible diagnostic coverage. `--wall-timeout` limits the total wall clock time of the model and cannot be confused with the number of simulating steps. Use a new output directory every time you want to overwrite it.

`episode.mp4` contains robot_view and field_view side by side, recorded from two cameras in the same environment at 50 FPS; `trajectory.npz` saves qpos/qvel/torque/time per control step; `config.json`, `episodes.csv`, `summary.json` generated by the official writer. `evaluation-finished.json` and `exit.json` must also confirm completion and save error at error.txt. Model models also include agent/prompt.json, complete events and events/no-images, observation pictures and agent-boundary.json (local source code submission, binary validation and model ID).

Source code and assets are read-only mounted and run-out is written; agent was only allowed to observe by independent relay. No direct model HTTP call. Neither upstream source code nor Codex is patched.
